executionNotes: The first CoreRegression attempt overlapped CoreBuild and failed to open the shared intermediate DLL; the dependent stage was rerun sequentially and passed 1104/1104.
The Unity recompile job record was pruned by the expected domain reload; recompile_status after reload reported completed, failed=false and no errors.
A post-review test request used an unsupported class filter and ran zero tests; the same layout case was then selected with the supported testName filter and passed 1/1.
The one-time scene generator refused non-empty output and restored the previously open saved scene after saving, reopening and validating Pinewatch.
notValidated: The layout scene has authored gameplay markers and Scene-view Gizmos, but no formal ObjectDefinition, entity Prefab, art, UGUI or session composition.
No PlayMode, Mono Player, IL2CPP Player, network or visual comparison was run for this slice.
Formal startup does not yet create GameSession from this scene; that integration remains an M0/M2 dependency.
